actions.description: Reset the instrument with the native reset (*CLS, *RST)
actions.name: reset_instrument

outputs.description: True once the native reset has been sent
outputs.name: reset

limit.reason: the set_mode docstring names these six modes; the function map applies them

facts.text: The plugin lists the Keithley 2100 as a 0D viewer multimeter
set_mode documents VDC, VAC, IDC, IAC, R2W and R4W as the supported measurement modes
set_mode picks the function from the mode name: Ohm2/R2W -> RES, Ohm4/R4W -> FRES, VDC/V -> VOLT:DC, VAC -> VOLT:AC, IDC/I -> CURR:DC and IAC -> CURR:AC
A configuration is sent as ':CONF:' followed by the function name, with an optional range and resolution appended
read() sends READ? and converts the answer to float
The identity, installed option card and last error are queried with *IDN?, *OPT? and SYST:ERR?
The VISA resource is opened with a newline write termination
close() opens all routes with ROUT:OPEN:ALL before it closes the VISA resource

measures.description: Measurement in the unit of the active function (volts, amperes or ohms); the upstream class does not say which unit is active
measures.name: reading

measures.description: Last instrument error returned by SYST:ERR?
measures.name: error

safe_state.description: the instrument is reset with *CLS and *RST and the driver no longer assumes the mode it applied
